<table align="center" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" class="tr-caption-container" style="margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;"><tbody><tr><td style="text-align: center;"><a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEi7qM9CHLd9zbFJufNiumnAFB-MRnltEUftHPJewbVqkb6fdbcWETy_BbCTMf247m4vxQzEVUzxORj1_oRvA-T4BFA2OkbSh3A_on0XKseTcvZqxvE1CbcvLWman7KzmxPyj-htmLrI-mFqmiaHA2srd01bI_ivKlOmpDthLXxls3-rbx5GLI75q_MCwBAE/s1408/1000042677.jpg" style="margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;"><img alt="A high-end modern desktop computer setup on a wooden desk, symbolizing the concept of information physics and how the universe processes data screens." border="0" data-original-height="768" data-original-width="1408" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEi7qM9CHLd9zbFJufNiumnAFB-MRnltEUftHPJewbVqkb6fdbcWETy_BbCTMf247m4vxQzEVUzxORj1_oRvA-T4BFA2OkbSh3A_on0XKseTcvZqxvE1CbcvLWman7KzmxPyj-htmLrI-mFqmiaHA2srd01bI_ivKlOmpDthLXxls3-rbx5GLI75q_MCwBAE/s1600/1000042677.jpg" title="Modern Computer Setup - Visualizing the It from Bit Information Physics Theory" /></a></td></tr><tr><td class="tr-caption" style="text-align: center;"><p class="Nb h_n"><h-text>🌌 <b>Is the Universe a Simulation of Data?</b></h-text></p><p class="Nb h_n"><h-text>Behind the modern computer screens that beam millions of colorful pixels to our eyes lies a profound question in physics: <b>Is our physical reality actually constructed from digital information codes?</b></h-text></p><p class="Nb h_n"><h-text><span hsize="16">Through the famous "<b>It from Bit</b>" theory proposed by physicist John Archibald Wheeler, all matter and energy in the universe fundamentally originate from bits of information. The computer sitting on your desk </span><span class="Lg honor-time" hsize="16" strref="today, is">today</span><span hsize="16"> is, in a way, a small replica of how the cosmic "screen of reality" processes data at every single moment.</span></h-text></p><p class="Nb h_n" data-h-fragment=""><h-text>In this blog post, we will dive into the <b>5 Models of the Cosmic Reality Map</b>—tracing the evolution from classical mechanics to modern quantum physics.</h-text></p></td></tr></tbody></table><p><br /></p><h2 style="text-align: left;">CORE ISSUES IN QUANTUM MECHANICS &amp; PHYSICS</h2><p><b>The Core Dilemma</b>: The relationship and conflict between the properties of a <b>Particle/Atom</b> (localized, static, discrete) and a <b>Wave</b> (spread out, uncertain, probability-based).</p><p><b>The Measurement Problem</b>: How a spread-out quantum wavefunction collapses into a definite particle/atomic point during physical interaction (<b>Decoherence</b>). This is driven by physical interactions, <b>NOT</b> by human eyesight or consciousness.</p><p><br /></p><h2 style="text-align: left;">THE DEFINITION OF "OBSERVER" &amp; THE UNCERTAINTY PRINCIPLE</h2><p><b>Observer</b>: Any detector or macroscopic physical object that interacts with a particle. It does not refer to the human mind or consciousness.</p><p><b>Heisenberg’s Uncertainty Principle</b>: A fundamental physical limit of the universe. It is not merely a mechanical disturbance during measurement (i.e., the instrument disturbing the particle), but an inherent, natural property of waves. Obtaining full, simultaneous knowledge of both position and momentum is fundamentally impossible.</p><p><br /></p><h2 style="text-align: left;">HISTORICAL EVOLUTION &amp; PHYSICS TERMINOLOGY</h2><p><b>Classical Physics (Pre-1900)</b>: Newton &amp; Maxwell — The universe is deterministic, orderly, and predictably certain.</p><p><b>Modern Physics (~126 Years, Founded in 1900)</b>: Planck, Einstein, Bohr, Heisenberg, Schrödinger — Quantum Mechanics and Relativity.</p><p><b>The Formative Era of Quantum Mechanics (1900–1935)</b>: Spans from Planck’s energy quanta (1900), De Broglie’s Hypothesis (1924: Particles behave as Waves), the Davisson-Germer Electron Diffraction Experiment (1927), to Schrödinger’s Cat Thought Experiment (1935).</p><p><b>Bell’s Theorem (1964) &amp; the 2022 Nobel Prize</b>: Established experimental proof that the universe cannot be <b>Local</b> and <b>Realistic</b> at the same time. This proves that old-school classical determinism (<b>Local Realism</b>) is physically impossible.</p><p><br /></p><h2 style="text-align: left;">QUALIA VS. OBJECTIVE REALITY</h2><p><b>Qualia / Subjective Perception</b>: Individual sensory experiences (e.g., a sighted person visualizing an atom vs. a blind person processing space through touch and sound).</p><p><b>Objective Reality</b>: The physical truth of the universe that exists and reacts according to the laws of physics, completely independent of how the human mind visualizes it.</p><p><br /></p><h2 style="text-align: left;">SYNTHESIS OF ANCIENT &amp; MODERN PHILOSOPHY</h2><p><b>Heraclitus (Flux/Panta Rhei)</b>: Nature is an ever-flowing river (proto-wave) governed by an orderly law (The Wave Equation).</p><p><b>Nagarjuna</b>: The quantum realm cannot be confined to the binary logic of "Exists", "Does Not Exist", "Both", or "Neither". Reality is <b>Sunyata</b> (empty of independent, inherent existence).</p><p><b>Theravada Abhidhamma</b>: Reality "flashes" or blinks at a frequency of trillions of moments per second, unifying <b>Sabhava</b> (atomic characteristics) with <b>Anicca/Paticcasamuppada</b> (the conditional flow of waves).</p><p><br /></p><h2 style="text-align: left;">5 MODELS OF THE COSMIC REALITY MAP (A Summary of the History of Thought)</h2><p><b>1. The Particle Block / "Static Marble" Model (Classical Atomism / Newton)</b>: Reality is built from hard, solid, and deterministic physical building blocks.</p><p><b>2. The Wave / "Flow &amp; Vibration" Model (Huygens, Maxwell, Heraclitus)</b>: There are no static objects; reality consists of motion patterns, ripples, and processes of change.</p><p><b>3. The Dualism / "Both Simultaneously" Model (Bohr, De Broglie, Daoism)</b>: Particles and waves are two different facets of the same underlying quantum reality (<b>Complementarity</b>).</p><p><b>4. The Interdependent Model (Nagarjuna, Abhidhamma, Carlo Rovelli)</b>: Discrete entities do not exist; there are only relationships, events, and conditional processes (<b>Relational Quantum Mechanics</b>).</p><p><b>5. The Digital / "Matrix Simulation" Model (Wheeler's "It from Bit" / Information Physics)</b>: Matter and energy are fundamentally based on digital code or data information processed on the screen of reality.</p>
